items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: At first there was two comedy acts in one comedy act, so we had to make that was a bit of the Nat Nazzara and one comedy act.

ctx.x: Now, what was the difference, performing with them and then as a separate act? How did you change your act?

Well, we changed our act by becoming a new comedian, a new comedy act, see. At first there was two comedy acts in one comedy act, so we had to make that was a bit of the Nat Nazzara and one comedy act. So that's (Unintelligible) John Bubbles, you see. They thought that would be nice.
